data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in BHR and STHO.

On October 14, 2026, BHR had a preliminary contested proxy filing (PREC14A) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1574085/000109690626001545/0001096906-26-001545-index.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue or set up a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
